name: panel-review
description: Trigger: reviewing a change boundary — uncommitted work, a branch diff, a stacked layer, or a pull request — through multiple named review lenses, or judging PR-readiness evidence before merging. One orchestrator fans out read-only lens agents that each apply one review concern, adversarially verifies every finding against the actual code, and synthesizes one severity-ranked report.
abstract: Adapted from citypaul's panel-review skill: a composable lens registry (built-in quality/readiness, defaults, auto-detected conditionals), isolated read-only lens agents judged against the change's own claim, adversarial per-finding verification with refuted/unverifiable kept distinct, the once-per-boundary mutation-evidence freshness model, and one severity-ranked report with conflicts and coverage gaps explicit.
